name: jev-effort
description: Sets the main conversation's reasoning effort per prompt with TypeSafe's Jev (via OpenRouter), reading recent conversation context. Shadow mode by default: logs what it would do without changing anything.

apiKey.title: Jev API key
apiKey.description: Bearer key for the endpoint (an OpenRouter key by default). Empty: the mod does nothing.

shadow.title: Shadow mode
shadow.description: Classify and log what effort it would set, but never change a request

sendContext.title: Send conversation context
sendContext.description: Send Claude's last reply, earlier prompts and last turn's tool names along with the prompt. Off: the prompt alone.

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to raise effort
minUpgradeConfidence.description: How sure Jev must be to raise effort above the session's

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to lower effort
minDowngradeConfidence.description: How sure Jev must be to lower effort below the session's

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long each prompt waits for Jev before going ahead unchanged (100-5000)

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: A transcript line per turn and a setup line per session; the status line and debug record are always written

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Model id; pin one (e.g. typesafe/jev-1.13) while evaluating. TypeSafe-direct: jev-latest

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Full System One URL. TypeSafe-direct: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone
